invariants.rationale: The fileName parameter must not be null since it is used as an argument in resolve(fileName) and in string concatenation within the catch block.
fileName should not be the empty string, as loading a file from an empty path is likely erroneous.
fileName should have non-whitespace characters, which follows from its usage as a file path.
Java file names should not contain the null character, or this would cause file handling errors.
fileName often contains at least one directory separator or an extension to denote a path or file type.
